search_summary: Crossref-based discovery identified new direct stacked-polyphase-bridge, GaN/SiC integrated-drive, traction-inverter, and modular medium-voltage candidates. Previously listed database records were excluded. All entries are metadata-only candidates; no quantitative values are verified.

candidates.title: GaN based High Power Density PCB Design for Aerial Vehicles Motor Drive Applications
candidates.journal_or_venue: 2025 IEEE International Workshop on Integrated Power Packaging (IWIPP)
expected_quantitative_pairs: Semiconductor voltage rating vs switching frequency
candidates.selection_rationale: Explicitly targets high-power-density GaN motor-drive hardware for aerial vehicles; promising benchmark for density, switching, efficiency, and cooling metrics.

candidates.title: Design and Analysis of a GaN-Based Megahertz Integrated Motor Drive for a PCB Motor
expected_quantitative_pairs: Semiconductor voltage rating vs switching frequency
candidates.selection_rationale: Integrated GaN motor drive with an explicitly megahertz operating concept; likely to contain prototype operating data and compactness-related metrics.

candidates.title: Comparison of Inverter Topologies Suited for Integrated Modular Motor Drive Applications
candidates.journal_or_venue: 2018 IEEE 18th International Power Electronics and Motion Control Conference (PEMC)

candidates.title: Design and Research on High Power Density Motor of Integrated Motor Drive System for Electric Vehicles
candidates.selection_rationale: Explicit high-power-density integrated electric-drive study; likely useful for system-level density, power, efficiency, and thermal/cooling benchmarking.

expected_quantitative_pairs: Semiconductor voltage rating vs switching frequency

candidates.title: Design and Verification of Multiphase Multilevel Traction Inverter

candidates.selection_rationale: Title explicitly indicates design verification of a multiphase multilevel traction inverter, making it a promising prototype benchmark for electrical and performance fields.

unresolved_targets: Approximately five additional experimentally demonstrated efficiency-plus-power-density paired records remain desirable.
Semiconductor current rating remains largely unresolved across integrated-drive and traction candidates.
Direct SPB prototype papers with clearly recoverable efficiency and semiconductor current ratings require further full-text-oriented searching.
verification_policy: All candidates are metadata/discovery records only. Scientific and numerical claims require later full-text evidence extraction.
